description: Defines the ModelMenuItem class which models a <menu-item> element in an XML configuration within the OFBiz widget framework. The class is responsible for parsing, representing, and rendering menu item XML elements, including links, conditions, actions, and nested menu items.

classes.name: ModelMenuItem
classes.description: Represents a <menu-item> element, encapsulating properties such as link, actions, conditions, sub-menu items, style attributes, and rendering logic. Supports nested menu items and portal page integration, designed to be immutable after construction.

classes.name: ModelMenuItem.MenuLink
classes.description: Inner class encapsulating URL and link parameters for a menu item, supporting different link sources such as XML elements, portal pages, and cloned links. Provides methods for retrieving link properties and rendering link strings.

methods.name: ModelMenuItem
methods.description: Constructs a ModelMenuItem by parsing an XML element representing a <menu-item>, including nested items, links, and conditions.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Implements the visitor pattern for traversing model widgets.

methods.name: addUpdateMenuItem
methods.description: Adds or updates a menu item in the list and map, merging if an item with the same name exists.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns the list of actions associated with this menu item.

methods.name: getAlign
methods.description: Returns alignment attribute, inherited from parent if not defined.

methods.name: getAlignStyle
methods.description: Returns alignment style, inherited if not explicitly set.

methods.name: getAssociatedContentId
methods.description: Returns the associated content ID as a flexible string expander.

methods.name: getAssociatedContentId(Map<String,Object>)
methods.description: Expands the associated content ID based on the provided context, or defaults.

methods.name: getCellWidth
methods.description: Returns the cell width attribute, defaulting from the model if necessary.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Returns the condition object governing visibility.

methods.name: getDisabledTitleStyle
methods.description: Returns disabled title style, inherited from parent or default.

methods.name: getDisableIfEmpty
methods.description: Returns the disable-if-empty attribute.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the entity name, inheriting if not explicitly set.

methods.name: getHideIfSelected
methods.description: Returns whether to hide if selected, inherited if null.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns the link object for this menu item.

methods.name: getMenuItemList
methods.description: Returns the list of nested menu items.

methods.name: getModelMenu
methods.description: Returns the parent ModelMenu object.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the menu item name, considering override.

methods.name: getOverrideName
methods.description: Returns the override name if set.

methods.name: getParentMenuItem
methods.description: Returns the parent menu item.

methods.name: getParentPortalPageId
methods.description: Returns the parent portal page ID as an expander.

methods.name: getParentPortalPageId(Map<String,Object>)
methods.description: Expands the portal page ID with context.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Returns the position of the menu item, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getSelectedStyle
methods.description: Returns style for selected state, inherited if not set.

methods.name: getSubMenu
methods.description: Returns the sub-menu attribute string.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title as a FlexibleStringExpander.

methods.name: getTitle(Map<String,Object>)
methods.description: Expands the title with given context.

methods.name: getTitleStyle
methods.description: Returns the style for the title, inherited if not explicitly set.

methods.name: getTooltip
methods.description: Returns the tooltip as a FlexibleStringExpander.

methods.name: getTooltip(Map<String,Object>)
methods.description: Expands the tooltip with context.

methods.name: getTooltipStyle
methods.description: Returns style for tooltip, inherited if not set.

methods.name: getWidgetStyle
methods.description: Returns widget style, inheriting if not explicitly specified.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Determines if this menu item is selected based on the context.

methods.name: mergeOverrideModelMenuItem
methods.description: Returns a new merged menu item with override properties.

methods.name: renderMenuItemString
methods.description: Renders the menu item to a writer, including portal pages if applicable.

methods.name: shouldBeRendered
methods.description: Evaluates whether the menu item should be rendered based on its condition.
